title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a transfer of funds to cover a projected deficit in the Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) sworn overtime…
text:
[Council File 26-1323]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a transfer of funds to cover a projected deficit in the Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) sworn overtime salary account.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Lee – Yaroslavsky), SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
REQUEST the Controller to transfer $20 million from within Fund No. 100/38, LAFD, including $10 million from Account No. 001012, Salaries Sworn, and $10 million from Account No. 1093, Overtime Constant Staffing, to Account No. 001092, Overtime Sworn, to cover a projected deficit in this account.
AUTHORIZE and INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer (CAO) and Controller to take any necessary actions and make any technical corrections to the above instructions in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Transfers $20 million within the Fire Department budget to cover a projected shortfall in sworn firefighter overtime pay.

outcome.text: Council adopted item forthwith (Oct 14, 2026); Council action final
